skill.name: Bible
skill.description: Accurate Bible study with proper citations, cross-references, original language insights, and interpretation methodology.
skill.summary: Citation Format (Critical) **Standard format**: Book Chapter:Verse — "John 3:16", "Genesis 1:1", "1 Corinthians 13:4-8" **Common errors to prevent**: - ❌ "Psalms 23" → ✅ "Psalm 23" (always singular) - ❌ "1st Corinthians"
